card.line: Nineveh was the great city of Assyria, where God sent Jonah to preach, and its people turned from their evil and God spared them.

moments.title: God sends Jonah
moments.text: God tells Jonah to go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Him.

moments.title: Jonah preaches in the city
moments.text: Jonah obeys the second time. He walks into Nineveh and announces that in forty more days the city will be overturned.

moments.title: Nineveh turns to God
moments.text: The Ninevites believe God and fast, from the greatest to the least. The king takes off his royal robe, sits in ashes, and calls everyone to turn from evil. God sees this and relents from the disaster He threatened.

moments.title: God cares about Nineveh
moments.text: When Jonah is angry, God asks whether He should not care about the great city, with more than 120,000 people and many cattle.

moments.title: Nahum's message against Nineveh
moments.text: Nahum's vision is a burden against Nineveh. It says the LORD is slow to anger but will not leave the guilty unpunished, and that He will make an end of Nineveh.
